verdictRationale: No AFF-A blocker, major or minor finding remains against the complete current eight-artifact Phase 1 subject. The AFF-B round 1 major traceability issue is resolved in the subject from an AFF-A requirements-traceability perspective by DR-007 and SR-010, but AFF-B must still re-review the same unchanged b0dd49069df5370ee4e37bb4500773efcdb04543016bb9b0a79acd423d49100a manifest.
